name: Oferta comercial de cupo
trigger: Customer agreed to hear the commercial offer after identity is verified.
content:
Run [tool id="${tool:get_credit_offer}"]. If available is false, explain briefly and offer [procedure id="${procedure:escalamiento}"] or end.
If available, present amount_text once. If interested, ask which term from available_terms, then [tool id="${tool:simulate_offer}"] and read spoken_summary verbatim before any OTP.
If they accept, [tool id="${tool:request_disbursement_otp}"], collect the code, [tool id="${tool:confirm_disbursement}"].
If they decline, respect immediately. If they ask not to be called commercially, [tool id="${tool:register_opt_out}"] with purpose comercial.
